title: FiRE: Fine-grained Ranking Evaluation for Machine Translation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30168v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Developing reliable machine translation (MT) systems hinges on our ability to distinguish superior translations from inferior ones. However, existing evaluation paradigms, whether limited to coarse overall rankings or misaligned with human preferences, fail to deliver interpretable, fine-grained feedback in reference-free settings. We present a Fine-Grained Ranking Evaluation method (FiRE) that leverages off-the-shelf large language models to perform criterion-driven pairwise comparison across three complementary dimensions: faithfulness, fluency, and consistency of style, instead of producing a single holistic judgment. To enable rigorous meta-evaluation of evaluation paradigms in the absence of any suitable testbed, we construct the first human-annotated, reference-free benchmark for fine-grained ranking evaluation, achieving substantial inter-annotator agreement. translated_title: FiRE：面向机器翻译的细粒度排序评估方法
translated_abstract: 开发可靠的机器翻译（MT）系统，关键在于我们能否区分优质译文与劣质译文。然而，现有的评估范式要么局限于粗粒度的整体排序，要么与人类偏好不一致，均无法在无参考设置下提供可解释的、细粒度的反馈。我们提出了一种细粒度排序评估方法FiRE，该方法利用现成的大语言模型，在三个互补维度——忠实度、流畅性和风格一致性——上执行基于标准的成对比较，而非产生单一的整体判断。为了在缺乏合适测试平台的情况下对评估范式进行严格的元评估，我们构建了首个用于细粒度排序评估的人工标注、无参考基准，并取得了较高的标注者间一致性。通过在该基准及现有MQM数据集上进行元评估，FiRE...
tldr: 该论文提出FiRE方法，利用现成大语言模型在忠实度、流畅性和风格一致性三个维度上进行基于标准的成对比较，实现机器翻译的可解释细粒度无参考排序评估，并构建了首个面向该任务的人工标注基准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FiRE, a fine-grained ranking evaluation method that leverages off-the-shelf LLMs to perform criterion-driven pairwise comparisons across faithfulness, fluency, and style consistency for reference-free MT evaluation, and introduces the first human-annotated reference-free benchmark for this task.
